title: introduce-frugal-rollout-guard-and-quantile-autotuner
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: We need a safe, tenant-aware rollout guard to prevent automated econ/autotune systems from regressing latency or cost SLOs during canary and staged rollouts. This PR implements a frugal rollout guard plus a quantile-based autotuner that adjusts per-tenant quantization profiles (and optionally batch/caching defaults) by observing latency and unit-econ signals at P50/P95/P99. The goals are: 1) block/auto-rollback a rollout that increases P95 latency beyond tenant thresholds or causes unit-cost above configured budgets, 2) provide a conservative autotuner that recommends quantization tiers and prefill/batch hints per tenant using statistically-significant quantile signals, and 3) expose safe-fallback policies and operator controls in the Console and CLI. What changed (high-level): added rollout guard runtime hooks that evaluate live telemetry and apply canary gates; added quantile_autotuner service that samples per-tenant request traces and produces candidate profiles; added redwoodctl/econ CLI knobs to run dry-runs and import suggestions; added Console controls to set tenant budget/latency tolerances and to view autotuner recommendations; added telemetry metrics and a small e2e smoketest. Rollout plan: feature flag gated (feature_econ_frugal_rollout) behind an opt-in tenant flag; start with dry-run suggestions on tenant groups, followed by canary gating configured at 5/20/50 percent. Backwards compatibility: default is no-op until flag is enabled; fallbacks always route to non-quantized or previous model variant. Checklist: - [x] runtime guard and gate evaluation - [x] autotuner algorithm + CLI import/export - [x] Console UI controls + telemetry dashboard - [x] unit + e2e tests - [x] docs and changelog entry - [x] safety: fallback to previous model when thresholds violated Related: builds on work in ENG-3142 (prefill telemetry) and complements ENG-1874 (tenant warmstart). Linear/Jira: ENG-4521, PM-881, SUP-1204
